Name: GitGuardian
Author: GitGuardian - support@gitguardian.com
Description:
The [GitGuardian](https://www.gitguardian.com/) solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables ingestion of [secret incidents](https://docs.gitguardian.com/api-docs) and [workspace audit logs](https://docs.gitguardian.com/platform/enterprise-administration/audit-log) from GitGuardian Enterprise.

**Underlying Microsoft Technologies used:**

This solution takes a dependency on the following technology, which might result in additional ingestion or operational costs:

• [Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework](https://aka.ms/Sentinel-CCP_Platform)
